about_the_game:
Purchase the Year 1 Season Pass and secure the Group 5 Revival Pack on launch. Race 5 fire-spitting icons from a wild, unhinged era of speed, noise, and excess when the rulebook was torn up and engineering vision ran rampant. Known as the “Silhouette Formula”, Group 5 transformed road cars into wide-bodied monsters with flared arches, mammoth wings, and ground-hugging aero to create one of the most thrilling eras in motorsport history.

This pack contains the following cars:

  • 1980 Ford Capri Zakpseed Group 5

  • 1982 Nissan Skyline Super Silhoutte

  • 1979 Porsche 935/80

  • 1982 Nissan 280 ZX IMSA GTX

  • 1978 BMW 320 Turbo Group 5
